title: So sánh hơn với tính từ
learningObjectiveVi: So sánh hai người hoặc vật bằng dạng -er hoặc more.
learningObjectiveEn: Compare two people or things using -er or more.

morphologyNotes: Choose -er for most short adjectives and more for most longer adjectives.

uses: Compare one quality between two entities.

usageConstraints: Choose the form from the intended meaning and sentence context.
